logger.doc:name: Log Fetching Control
logger.message: Fetching reporting control for Entity: #[vars.entityCode default p('compliance.entityCode')], Report Type: #[vars.reportType default p('compliance.reportType')]

db:select.doc:name: Query Compliance Control Table
db:select.db:sql:
SELECT
c.control_id,
c.entity_code,
c.report_type,
c.last_success_period_end,
c.current_sequence_number,
(SELECT COALESCE(MAX(r.sequence_number), 0)
FROM compliance_report_runs r
WHERE r.entity_code = c.entity_code
AND r.report_type = c.report_type
AND (
(:manualPeriodEnd IS NOT NULL AND (DATE(r.period_end) = DATE(:manualPeriodEnd) OR r.period_end = :manualPeriodEnd))
OR
(:manualPeriodEnd IS NULL AND (DATE(r.period_end) = DATE(DATE_ADD(c.last_success_period_end, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) OR c.last_success_period_end IS NULL))
)
) AS max_period_sequence
FROM compliance_report_control c
WHERE c.entity_code = :entityCode AND c.report_type = :reportType
LIMIT 1

logger.doc:name: Log Period Calculated
logger.message: Calculated Period: #[vars.runContext.periodStart] to #[vars.runContext.periodEnd], Run ID: #[vars.runContext.runId], Seq: #[vars.runContext.sequenceNumber], Is Revision: #[vars.runContext.isRevision]

logger.doc:name: Log Audit Insert
logger.message: Creating RUNNING audit record in compliance_report_runs for Run ID: #[vars.runContext.runId]

db:insert.doc:name: Insert RUNNING Audit Record
db:insert.db:sql:
INSERT INTO compliance_report_runs (
run_id, entity_code, entity_name, report_type,
period_start, period_end, sequence_number, is_revision,
record_count, total_amount, customer_count, completeness_result,
is_nil_report, trigger_source, run_status, correlation_id, started_at
) VALUES (
:runId, :entityCode, :entityName, :reportType,
:periodStart, :periodEnd, :sequenceNumber, :isRevision,
0, 0.00, 0, 'PENDING',
false, :triggerSource, 'RUNNING', :correlationId, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
)
db:insert.db:input-parameters:
#[{
runId: vars.runContext.runId,
entityCode: vars.runContext.entityCode,
entityName: vars.runContext.entityName,
reportType: vars.runContext.reportType,
periodStart: vars.runContext.periodStart,
periodEnd: vars.runContext.periodEnd,
sequenceNumber: vars.runContext.sequenceNumber,
isRevision: vars.runContext.isRevision,
triggerSource: vars.runContext.triggerSource,
correlationId: vars.runContext.correlationId
}]

logger.doc:name: Log Extraction Query
logger.message: Executing streamed extraction query for Period [#[vars.runContext.periodStart] to #[vars.runContext.periodEnd]] with fetchSize #[p('compliance.fetchSize')]

db:select.doc:name: Streamed Extraction Select
db:select.db:sql:
SELECT
t.transaction_id,
t.transaction_timestamp,
t.account_number,
c.customer_id,
c.customer_name,
c.customer_type,
t.transaction_type,
t.channel,
t.currency,
t.amount,
t.counterparty_name,
t.counterparty_country,
f.flag_code,
f.flag_reason,
f.flagged_at,
f.reviewer,
f.review_status
FROM transaction_flags f
JOIN transactions t ON f.transaction_id = t.transaction_id
JOIN customers c ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE ( (:isHistoricalReprocess = TRUE AND f.review_status = 'REPORTED') OR (:isHistoricalReprocess = FALSE AND f.review_status = 'PENDING_REPORT') ) AND f.flagged_at >= :periodStart AND f.flagged_at < :periodEnd
ORDER BY f.flagged_at ASC, t.transaction_id ASC

logger.doc:name: Log Aggregate Query
logger.message: Executing independent aggregate query for completeness comparison.

db:select.doc:name: Aggregate Select
db:select.db:sql:
SELECT
COUNT(f.flag_id) AS total_records,
COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0.00) AS total_amount,
COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS total_customers
FROM transaction_flags f
JOIN transactions t ON f.transaction_id = t.transaction_id
JOIN customers c ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE ( (:isHistoricalReprocess = TRUE AND f.review_status = 'REPORTED') OR (:isHistoricalReprocess = FALSE AND f.review_status = 'PENDING_REPORT') ) AND f.flagged_at >= :periodStart AND f.flagged_at < :periodEnd

db:select.doc:name: Select Last 5 Successful Runs
db:select.db:sql:
SELECT
run_id,
record_count,
total_amount,
customer_count,
run_status
FROM compliance_report_runs
WHERE entity_code = :entityCode
AND report_type = :reportType
AND run_status = 'SUCCESS'
ORDER BY completed_at DESC
LIMIT 5

db:update.doc:name: Update Run Audit Status
db:update.db:sql:
UPDATE compliance_report_runs SET
record_count = :recordCount,
total_amount = :totalAmount,
customer_count = :customerCount,
completeness_result = :completenessResult,
is_nil_report = :isNilReport,
output_file_path = :outputFilePath,
archive_file_path = :archiveFilePath,
summary_file_path = :summaryFilePath,
checksum = :checksum,
notification_status = :notificationStatus,
notification_mode = :notificationMode,
run_status = :runStatus,
error_message = :errorMessage,
completed_at = CASE WHEN :runStatus IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE completed_at END
WHERE run_id = :runId
db:update.db:input-parameters:
#[{
runId: vars.runContext.runId,
recordCount: vars.runMetrics.recordCount default 0,
totalAmount: vars.runMetrics.totalAmount default 0.00,
customerCount: vars.runMetrics.customerCount default 0,
completenessResult: vars.runMetrics.completenessResult default 'PENDING',
isNilReport: (vars.runMetrics.recordCount default 0) == 0,
outputFilePath: vars.outputSubmissionFilePath,
archiveFilePath: vars.archiveSubmissionFilePath,
summaryFilePath: vars.archiveSummaryFilePath,
checksum: vars.runMetrics.checksum default 'NIL_REPORT',
notificationStatus: vars.notificationStatus default 'PENDING',
notificationMode: vars.notificationMode default 'ATTACHMENT',
runStatus: vars.currentRunStatus default 'RUNNING',
errorMessage: vars.runErrorMessage
}]

logger.doc:name: Log Advancing Control
logger.message: Advancing reporting control for #[vars.runContext.entityCode] to #[vars.runContext.periodEnd], seq: #[vars.runContext.sequenceNumber]

db:update.doc:name: Update Compliance Control Table
db:update.db:sql:
UPDATE compliance_report_control SET
last_success_period_end = :periodEnd,
current_sequence_number = :sequenceNumber,
updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE entity_code = :entityCode AND report_type = :reportType

logger.doc:name: Log Reprocess No Control Advance
logger.message: Historical reprocess completed. Preserving master control timeline; master pointer not advanced.

db:update.doc:name: Update Flags to REPORTED
db:update.db:sql:
UPDATE transaction_flags SET
review_status = 'REPORTED',
report_run_id = :runId
WHERE review_status = 'PENDING_REPORT'
AND flagged_at >= :periodStart
AND flagged_at < :periodEnd
